title: Unforgettable experience
text:
Beautiful experience. Very punctual in the pickup. The pilot, Pepe, was very kind, willing to answer all questions, and he explains about the trip, providing a lot of security for those who have not had experience in hot air balloon flights.
 I was impressed by the landing, where he told us, there it landed.
author: joberov

title: 🎈✨ A dream among the clouds above the Ebro Delta 🌅
text:
✨🎈🌅 A magical and unforgettable experience about the Ebro Delta 🌅🎈✨

There are not enough words to describe how wonderful this balloon flight over the Ebro Delta has been. From the first moment I felt a huge emotion 💖, mixed with nerves, excitement and a lot of happiness 😍. Watching the sunrise from the sky, floating gently between incredible landscapes, rice paddies and the absolute calm of the delta, was simply spectacular 🌄✨.

The sense of freedom up there is indescribable 🎈☁️. Everything seemed like a dream: the silence, the endless views, the colors of the sunrise and that special peace 🕊
author: 309neream

title: Endeavourable experience with a great human team behind.
text: Unbelievable experience, it is indescribable the feeling of calm that you live up there and how you enjoy the landscape but the best of all is the human team that forms Globus Kon-Tiki, the quality in the treatment, the time that they dedicate to you and the explanations and experiences that they provide make that even more enjoy the flight.
author: gustavocW349ST

title: Kon-Tiki Hot Air Balloon flight! It was Magic with our pilot Miguel
text:
Hot air balloon ride at sunrise to view the Monserrat Mountains outside Barcelona, Spain.
It included transportation from Barcelona which was about 1 hour from the flight location. Our driver (Monserrat- yes her name was coincidently the same as the mountains ) was on time, safe and the van was clean and comfy. 
Company was great at communicating prior to the trip as we traveled from the US and only speak English.  Pick up and drop off was SO CONVENIENT! 
The hot air balloon experience was off the charts! 
It was our 1st flight and boy did it make an impression! STUNNING VIEWS! tranquil and aw
author: Ladyhawk124

title: Thinking of booking this? You should.
text: Fantastic experience with an experienced crew. Pickup/drop off was seamless. Company sent pictures taken during the flight afterwards. Joseph the pilot was extremely knowledgeable.  Highlight of our trip to Spain!!

title: Hot Air Balloon
